contributionMap.claim: Method: the substitution u_i = x_i + y_i (and, for chordal graphs, z_w ↦ Σ_{v∈N[w]} z_v at a simplicial vertex) makes multiplication by the sum of the variables block-diagonal with shifted Boolean-algebra blocks; Wilson's diagonal form then gives every rank in every characteristic

limitationTriage.limitation: The splitting needs a private leaf at every vertex (whiskered case) or a simplicial vertex at each step (chordal case)
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do cycles, tadpoles with long cycles, partially whiskered and very well-covered graphs admit a similar splitting?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Holleben-Nicklasson Example 3.18 (very well-covered, has the WLP) examined; tadpole paper read; elimination stops at the cycle

limitationTriage.limitation: Prime-characteristic thresholds for unequal higher truncation exponents
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Which primes preserve maximal rank on the monomial complete-intersection blocks of Theorem 6.1?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: reduced by the splitting to the known positive-characteristic behaviour of monomial complete intersections; not worked out

limitationTriage.limitation: Path and lollipop corollaries rely on a finite computer check for short lengths
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the finite range exact and independently checked?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: exact integer evaluation of the Theorem 7.3 criterion for n ≤ 24 (paths) and n ≤ 22 (lollipops) and well beyond; witness inequalities checked to n = 5000 and proved analytically above the range; lists agree with the published characteristic-zero classifications; re-review recomputed them with its own script

limitationTriage.limitation: Check scripts used bare assert in the original bundle
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks stay active under python -O?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: asserts replaced by explicit checks; two negative controls (Nguyen-Tran list with 8 added; WLP threshold forced to 2) exit 1 under -O in the replay and in CI
